adjudication.rationale: In `packages/app-store/_utils/oauth/parseRefreshTokenResponse.ts`, the helper now `throw new Error("Invalid refreshed tokens were returned")` on any `safeParse` failure, without including the underlying Zod error or the provider’s raw response. In `packages/app-store/office365calendar/lib/CalendarService.ts`, this replaces prior behavior that logged `tokenResponse.error` and `responseJson` on parse failure. Zoom similarly switches from `zoomRefreshedTokenSchema.safeParse(responseBody)` to `parseRefreshTokenResponse(...)`, meaning failures will now throw a context-free error instead of returning a non-success parse result for the caller to inspect/handle. This is a concrete, diff-grounded loss of diagnosability / change in error-handling semantics, though not necessarily a functional defect.
